# CellFillPattern

```csharp
public enum CellFillPattern
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

The pattern of a cell's fill, as Excel's Format Cells > Fill > Pattern Style lists them: drawn in [CellStyle.PatternColor](SharpCell.CellStyle.md#patterncolor) over [CellStyle.Fill](SharpCell.CellStyle.md#fill).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="solid"></a>`Solid` | 0 | No pattern: the cell is filled with [CellStyle.Fill](SharpCell.CellStyle.md#fill). |
| <a id="darkgray"></a>`DarkGray` | 1 | 75% gray dots. |
| <a id="mediumgray"></a>`MediumGray` | 2 | 50% gray dots. |
| <a id="lightgray"></a>`LightGray` | 3 | 25% gray dots. |
| <a id="gray125"></a>`Gray125` | 4 | 12.5% gray dots. |
| <a id="gray0625"></a>`Gray0625` | 5 | 6.25% gray dots. |
| <a id="darkhorizontal"></a>`DarkHorizontal` | 6 | Thick horizontal stripes. |
| <a id="darkvertical"></a>`DarkVertical` | 7 | Thick vertical stripes. |
| <a id="darkdown"></a>`DarkDown` | 8 | Thick stripes down to the right. |
| <a id="darkup"></a>`DarkUp` | 9 | Thick stripes up to the right. |
| <a id="darkgrid"></a>`DarkGrid` | 10 | A thick grid. |
